databaseScope: Read-only current package prepared before the proposed-road classification repair. Feature IDs refer to this checksum only.
realCaseMethod: For each frozen pair, resolve the original target bridge by stable OSM source ID, then independently audit start -> every original bridge vertex -> end in both orientations. Query the full witness envelope. Source-node-connected underpass members are grouped for the existing independent audit. Invalid witness attempts do not prove that no other detour exists.

realCases.plannedRoadFinding: 1215311 is proposed way/327549917 in this package; removing it alone does not validate either witness because other road and water violations remain.

independentWitnessAudit.implementation: Existing tools/routing_crossing_pilot.py audit with Shapely; full route and source geometries, no road-policy relaxation

confirmedSyntheticDefect.cause: The endpoint has no valid regular-grid connector, but has a valid full-segment connection to a nearby mapped bridge entrance. The graph omitted endpoint-to-portal links and threw GridConnectionUnavailable before searching the valid bridge path.
confirmedSyntheticDefect.repair: For each endpoint with zero original regular-grid connections, add full-segment-validated links to every eligible portal end within the same rounded eight-cell row/column neighbourhood. Preserve existing connections and portal topology for endpoints already connected to the grid. Only confirmed entrance vertices of modern underpass networks are eligible. Surface connectors cannot grant underground road-crossing permission.
negativeControls: internal underpass node cannot be entered as a surface entrance
confirmedSyntheticDefect.fullSegmentValidation: Every returned segment in both positive fixture types is re-evaluated by TerrainEvaluator.Evaluate; bridge witnesses also have an independent valid Shapely audit. Endpoints, bridge-candidate versus approved-crossing metrics, and underpass passage evidence are asserted.
confirmedSyntheticDefect.limitation: This repairs a demonstrated zero-grid-connection defect. It does not establish completeness when an endpoint has grid connections into a disconnected component, between separate portals, through arbitrary narrow corridors, or outside the bounded search area. No increase for the original 88 pairs is inferred.

portalOrderingRegression.fixture: A reachable first bridge entrance has a blocked continuation through a building. A separate curved bridge supplies the only valid crossing. Both source orderings and both endpoint directions are checked.
portalOrderingRegression.counterfactual: Temporarily stop adding eligible portal links once the endpoint dictionary has its first connection.
portalOrderingRegression.restoration: Original Graph source bytes restored in finally; all 10 focused cases passed after rebuilding restored production code.

commands.independentInvestigation: uv run --project tools/GeodataPreparation --locked python tools/routing_portal_witnesses.py --data <package-directory> --output artifacts/portal-witnesses.json
commands.witnessToolTests: uv run --project tools/GeodataPreparation --locked python -m unittest discover -s tools/GeodataPreparation/tests -p test_routing_portal_witnesses.py -v

localArtifacts.scope: Artifact basenames from the recorded local run; regenerate portable witness JSON with the command above.
